name: James L.
quote:
We considered a couple bids and went with Prime due to all the positive reviews here on Yelp and also recommendations from family. We are not disappointed and cost was not out of line. Our project was not complicated as we were limited in space and didn't want to take down a wall. So we didn't really have any good opportunities to move things. So we basically took to original kitchen layout and kept it but updated everything. We added a counter over looking our family room which turned out to be a great add and also a nice bench with storage underneath. We also had Prime change our flooring through out the lower level and painted most of the rooms.

Daniel Z. and Ilay (Project Management) were great to work with. They went out of their way to address all of our concerns and slight tweaks along the way. All of the craftsman they sent out were courteous and professional. I was particularly happy that there was no nickel and diming as tweaks came.

I would recommend they and may use them again for future project.

name: Yun Chun L.
quote: We reached out to Prime Design and Build for a bathroom remodel and worked with Ethan. He was helpful, attentive, and very responsive. He also worked efficiently--our first meeting covered the same level of detail in 30 minutes that other GCs took an hour for, which we appreciated. In the end, we went with another option, but Prime Design and Build remained a top contender throughout. There was never any high-pressure selling; instead, Ethan did everything he could to adjust the proposal to fit our budget. If you're looking for a GC, I'd recommend reaching out to them for a proposal.

name: David W.
quote:
Change is very difficult. It's also costly. And scary even. This company took the sting out of it. They aren't the cheapest out there, but once you see the work they do, it's almost a bargain. I did my research and wanted to find something in the middle- quality without excess. I found these guys.

My project manager, Elijah was a total professional and also happens to be a real nice human being. His crew is even better (sorry, Eli). They listened and wanted my input. I grew to trust them quickly and started asking for their opinions about various things along the way to help me decide what to do.

As stressful at it is to have people in your house everyday making lots of noise for weeks, I'm actually going to miss these guys.

I will definitely hire them in future. I already have new projects in mind, and once the money is there, I'll pick up the phone and get to see my new friends again.
